d:
Marc Short, former chief of staff to Vice President Mike Pence, says congressional scrutiny of Jensen Huang is unlikely to end with his December appearances, predicting Democrats will revisit the Nvidia controversy after taking control of Congress in January. Short also calls President Trump’s intervention in Huang’s reinstatement a “dangerous precedent.” He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power."
